Take-profits are hitting reliably (0.90-0.93) which is healthy, but the win/loss asymmetry plus the move10-20 veto being necessary at all indicates momentum_min_move_bps threshold is too permissive for mid-range moves. The 'alone' bucket (36 trades, -$4.26, experimental reduce_confidence) and price0.70+ bucket (experimental reduce_confidence, -$4.05) are smaller samples trending negative but not yet validated.
